items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: Well they played the numbers that they're playing the dead, the Dixieland numbers like Piano Moore and Dogtown Struthers Ball and Clarinet Marmalet and Fidgeted Feet.

ctx.x: And what kind of music did these bands play? Howard and Henry Allen and the Camelia that was there.

Well they played the numbers that they're playing the dead, the Dixieland numbers like Piano Moore and Dogtown Struthers Ball and Clarinet Marmalet and Fidgeted Feet. The fact that they played all the old numbers that they're using the dead that's in demand.
